paragraphs.text: Dean Uvilda Mistcoiler was a djinn and a skilled wizard who served as a teacher at the Prismari College within Strixhaven University, located on the plane of Arcavios .

As a master of artistic magical techniques, Uvilda was known for her tireless dedication to her craft, never needing to sleep, a common trait among djinn from Arcavios . When not focusing on her teaching responsibilities, she devoted herself to honing her skills across all forms of water-based elemental magic.

Uvilda was especially renowned for her personalized approach to instructing students; after reviewing a student's work, she often offered one insightful piece of advice that could profoundly change their understanding and perspective of magic and art.

She held a firm belief that true artistic mastery originates in the mind, valuing precision and intention above all else. To Uvilda, carefully calculated brush strokes and deliberate arrangement of elements were what separated genuine, impactful art from chaos or disorder. Her patience was frequently tested by Dean Nassari , whose exuberant and flamboyant style disrupted her meticulous work; Uvilda has even joked about enrolling in Quandrix College to learn ways to reduce their disruptive energy.
During the New Phyrexian Invasion , most Strixhaven teachers were killed. Uvilda's role as Dean of Perfection of the Prismari College was later taken over by Veyran .
